messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: vendors@northforge.co, Sofia Ramirez <sofia@northforge.co>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Merchant master enrollment: legal-name audit & PO steward confirmation

Hi Sofia / Northforge team —

Thanks for starting the onboarding process with Redwood. Before we can create the vendor master record and route POs correctly, we need to confirm a few legal and finance details so our ERP mappings are accurate. Please confirm the following and attach any supporting docs (W9, certificate of incorporation, bank remittance instructions) if available: 

- Legal entity name exactly as appears on tax documents
- DBA / trade names (if different)
- Registered business address (street, city, state, postal code, country)
- Tax ID / EIN (or local equivalent)
- Primary AP contact for invoices (name, email, phone) and preferred remit method (ACH, wire)
- PO acceptance contact (name/email) and if POs must be sent to a specific mailbox or system
- Any subsidiaries or master/child account relationships we should know about

Attached is our vendor onboarding form to speed collection. If you can return the completed form and a scanned W9 by end of week, I’ll push the record into staging and route a test PO for validation.

Notes for Northforge: Marcus in finance will verify remit instructions and Jordan will confirm preferred PO attribute mapping for sourcing.

Thanks —

Kimberly Park
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), vendor-file-checklist.txt

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the note — attaching the completed onboarding form and our W9. Quick answers inline below and in the form: 

- Legal entity: Northforge Materials, Inc.
- DBA: Northforge Materials (no separate DBA)
- Registered address: 410 Cedar Park Dr, Suite 200, Portland, OR 97204, USA
- EIN: 93-8721164
- AP contact: Paul Lemaire, paul.lemaire@northforge.co, +1 (503) 555-0164; preferred remit: ACH (prior validation required)
- PO acceptance: Please send POs to purchases@northforge.co (monitored by procurement team).
- Subsidiaries: None. Single legal entity.

We have also attached a remittance instructions PDF produced by our bank. Let us know if you need bank letter of authorization.

Best,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of Supply Operations
Northforge Materials

Attachments: northforge_onboarding_form.pdf, northforge_w9.pdf, bank_remit_instructions.pdf

Hi Sofia / Paul —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for the attachments. I pulled the details into staging and there are two small clarifications before we finalize: 

1) The remittance PDF lists an ACH account reference that differs from the routing number on the W9 metadata — can you confirm which bank details we should store as primary remit? Marcus is copied for verification.
2) For PO processing, does Northforge require a PO number on the invoice to match for automated matching? If so, confirm whether the PO number should appear in the invoice subject line or in the invoice body as a separate field.

If you confirm both items, I’ll create the master record with legal name exactly as ‘Northforge Materials, Inc.’ and set purchases@northforge.co as the PO acceptance mailbox. We’ll also create a finance-only remit instruction flag so Marcus’s team can require the second-step bank validation before payment.

Next steps I’ll take after confirmation:
- Create vendor master in staging and send a test PO (non-financial) to purchases@northforge.co
- Jordan will work with your procurement team to confirm PO line-item attributes (catalog code / commodity mapping)
- Once test PO validated, we’ll flip the record to production and share vendor ID and AP routing

Thanks —
Kimberly

I ran the staging import and validated the fields Kim pulled in: legal name set to ‘Northforge Materials, Inc.’, PO mailbox purchases@northforge.co, AP contact Paul Lemaire. I added a custom attribute mapping so PO line items with commodity codes starting with NF- map to our ‘Materials — Northforge’ catalog.

If both of you are aligned I’ll flip the record to production on 2025-07-30 after the test PO passes.
